column3: Exact parallel: each self receives its deeds in full without injustice.
Speech that is not enacted sharpens the focus on actual deeds and conduct.
Exact final-day settlement of every self for what it earned, without injustice.
God's knowledge of what people do directly supports the focus's comprehensive knowledge.
The immediately preceding court scene supplies the record, witnesses, and just judgment.
It states full repayment for works, with differentiated degrees and no injustice.
God knowing what people conceal extends the focus from visible acts to their inward content.
In the same passage, acquired gains fail to avert their resulting consequence.
Divine knowledge and testimony establish a broader warrant for the focus's knowing judgment.
Each self finds its good and evil deeds present on the final day.

Creation in truth is explicitly tied to each self being recompensed for its acquisition without injustice.

Righteous workers enter the Garden and are not wronged even a speck.

Righteous deeds receive a good life and a reward according to the best deeds performed.

God does not let the reward of those who do good works be lost.

God repays those who do evil for their deeds and rewards those who do good with the best return.

God informs people of all they did, having enumerated what they forgot, while witnessing everything.
At the final gathering, God informs people of what they did and has full knowledge of all things.
A person is informed of what they sent ahead and left behind.

The recipient of the right-hand record receives an easy account.
Whoever performs an atom's weight of good will see it.

Each has a share of what they earned, under God's swift reckoning.

God gives full wages for recitation and prayerful spending, then increases from His bounty.
Affliction is tied to what hands have earned, while much is pardoned.
Every person is held in pledge for what they earned.
Those who bring evil are cast into the Fire and are recompensed only for what they used to do.

On that day a person remembers what they strove for.
The day when secrets are tested reinforces that judgment reaches concealed realities.

A believer doing righteous deeds fears neither injustice nor deprivation.

Those whose scales are heavy are the successful at final judgment.
Those whose scales are light lose themselves in the Fire.
Good deeds receive more than their like, while evil deeds receive only their due return.
Even a mustard-seed deed hidden in rock, heaven, or earth is brought forth by God.
